def choose_move(observation):
    agent_state = observation.get('agent', {})
    position = agent_state.get('position', (0, 0))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])

    def get_closest_target(targets):
        return min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0] - position[0]) + abs(t[1] - position[1]), default=None)

    # Prioritize resources, then enemies, then border
    for target_list in [resources, enemies, border]:
        if target_list:
            target = get_closest_target(target_list)
            dx = target[0] - position[0]
            dy = target[1] - position[1]
            # Normalize to -1, 0, 1
            dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
            dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
            return [dx, dy]

    # Default move when no targets
    return [0, 0]
